# verbatim so tests/server/account-core.mjs AC8 can compare the core's REJECT templates with them. Do not edit.

function volWhy(sym, lots) {

  if (lots > mx + 1e-9) return `Maximum size is ${lotsWord(sym, mx)} per order`;
  return '';
